<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1784056_sixscape.ScheduleForDeviceSync</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ScheduleForDeviceSync</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ScheduleForDeviceSync = Class.create();
ScheduleForDeviceSync.prototype = {

    syncDevices: function() {
        try {
            // Get Token
            var tokenObj = new get_token();
            var response = tokenObj.TestConnection();

            if (!response || response.length < 2) {
                throw new Error('Invalid response from Token API.');
            }
            var status = response[0];
            var responseBody = response[1];
            var authToken;
            if (status === 200) {
                var parsedResponse = JSON.parse(responseBody);
                authToken = "Bearer " + parsedResponse.authToken;
            } else {
                throw new Error("Error while generating the authentication token.");
            }

            var existing_device_list = [];
            var query_table = new GlideRecordSecure('x_1784056_sixscape_device');
            query_table.query();
            while (query_table.next()) {
                existing_device_list.push(query_table.getValue('device_id'));
            }

            var profile_group_ids = [];
            var query_table = new GlideRecordSecure('x_1784056_sixscape_profile');
            query_table.query();
            while (query_table.next()) {
                profile_group_ids.push(query_table.getValue('profile_group_id'));
            }

            var endpoint = gs.getProperty("x_1784056_sixscape.End Point") || "";
            // Remove trailing slash if present
            if (endpoint.endsWith("/")) {
                endpoint = endpoint.substring(0, endpoint.length - 1);
            }
            var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
            var mid_server = gs.getProperty("x_1784056_sixscape.Mid Server Name");
            if (mid_server != "") {
                r.setMIDServer(mid_server);
                r.setEccParameter('skip_sensor', 'true');
            }

            for (var group_id = 0; group_id < profile_group_ids.length; group_id++) {
                var skip = 0,
                    top = 1;
                while (true) {
                    r.setHttpMethod("get");
                    r.setRequestHeader("Authorization", authToken);
                    r.setRequestHeader('User-Agent', 'snow');
                    r.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
                    r.setEndpoint(endpoint + "/v1/device");
                    r.setQueryParameter("deviceOwnerId", "eq " + profile_group_ids[group_id]);
                    r.setQueryParameter("$skip", skip);
                    r.setQueryParameter("$top", top);
                    r.setHttpTimeout(30000);
                    r.setHttpTimeout(30000);
                    var deviceResponse = r.executeAsync();
                    if (deviceResponse.haveError()) {
                        responseBody = deviceResponse.getBody();
                        try {
                            var res = JSON.parse(responseBody);
                            message = res.title;
                        } catch (err) {
                            message = responseBody;
                        }
                        throw new Error(message);
                    } else {
                        responseBody = deviceResponse.getBody();
                        responseBody = JSON.parse(responseBody);
                        for (var profile = 0; profile < responseBody.length; profile++) {
                            gs.error("DDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDD " + JSON.stringify(profile[0]));
                        }
                    }
                    if (responseBody.length !== top) {
                        break;
                    }
					skip = skip + top;
                }
            }
			gs.error("Completed");

        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error("Error in schedulerForDevicesSync: " + ex.message);
            throw ex; // rethrow original error to preserve stack trace
        }
    },

    type: 'ScheduleForDeviceSync'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-10 11:25:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>728b499bc362261087613342b4013194</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ScheduleForDeviceSync</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Sixscape IDcentral" source="x_1784056_sixscape">42bb04c3c3a6a21087613342b40131c0</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Sixscape IDcentral">42bb04c3c3a6a21087613342b40131c0</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_728b499bc362261087613342b4013194</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-10 11:44:12</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
